title: Starfish Space loses contact with 1st 'Otter' servicing spacecraft, ending NASA tech-demo mission
caption:
The Starfish Space Otter 24C satellite has been declared lost. A radio malfunction during its commissioning phase prevented the craft from completing its planned NASA technology demonstration.

Source: Space - Starfish Space loses contact with 1st 'Otter' servicing spacecraft, ending NASA tech-demo mission
